details.Project Title: ILLEGAL DUMP SITE CLEANUP SERVICES - VEHICLES
Categories: 562998 - All Other Miscellaneous Waste Management Services
details.Address: County of Mendocino 501 Low Gap Road Room 1010 Attn Grants Division Ukiah, California 95482

Contact Information.Bids to: Mendocino County Executive Office Attn: Grants Division 501 Low Gap Road, Room 1010 Ukiah, CA 95482

Description.Scope of Services: This Request for Proposal (RFP) announces the intent of the County of Mendocino to solicit proposals from qualified contractors for illegal dump site cleanup services via removal and disposal of abandoned, wrecked, dismantled, and inoperative vehicles from tribal land funded by the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program in and around the community of Covelo. The purpose of the RFP is to select a properly licensed company to provide turnkey services for the cleanup of illegal dump sites in and around Covelo. Another Request for Proposal (RFP) has been issued for the same project for removal and disposal of solid waste, and interested vendors are invited to submit applications for both opportunities The selected contractor will work under the direction of the County and in collaboration with the Round Valley Indian Tribes (RVIT). The contractor will be responsible for efficiently and properly removing illegally dumped junk vehicles from designated locations identified by the County of Mendocino and RVIT. The goal of the project is to restore these sites to a safe and clean condition.
Description.Notes: New vendors can register as a Mendocino County Planet Bids vendor at, https://www.mendocinocounty.org/departments/general-services/central-services/open-rfp-quotes-bids

summary.Project Title: ENVIRONMENTAL CONSULTING SERVICES FOR THE WILDFIRE COMMUNITY RESILIENCE PROJECT

details.Project Title: ENVIRONMENTAL CONSULTING SERVICES FOR THE WILDFIRE COMMUNITY RESILIENCE PROJECT

Contact Information.Bids to: Mendocino County Executive Office Attn: Christy Gard 501 Low Gap Road, Room 1010 Ukiah, CA 95482

Description.Scope of Services: This Request for Proposal (RFP) announces the intent of the County of Mendocino to contract with an Environmental Consulting vendor for the Wildfire Community Resilience Project. This project proposes to create defensible space around critical facilities: the Brooktrails Fire Department, the Brooktrails Township Community Services District offices, Sherwood School, Willits Municipal Airport, and the Lake Ada Rose and Lake Emily drinking water reservoirs with associated treatment facilities. This project will also conduct vegetation management along the Sherwood corridor and internal Brooktrails roads to ensure clear and safe passage for evacuations during fire events and other natural disasters. The County is currently funded for Phase I, which consists of LiDAR mapping, outreach, fuels reduction prescription development, and CEQA analysis. The selected vendor will assist the County to meet all state and federal environmental obligations, including CEQA analysis, develop fuels reduction prescription, and develop bid documents to complete Phase I of the Project.
Description.Notes: New vendors can register as a Mendocino County Planet Bids vendor at, https://www.mendocinocounty.org/departments/general-services/central-services/open-rfp-quotes-bids
